In short:
✅ A helper understands the quest well
✅ Knows how to use Discord
✅ Has a passion for helping people
 For more info - check the <#1216727500487659611> channel
All good, no worries :) Let me know if you change your mind. Happy weekend and holidays! ✨
Go to the #helper-applications channel on Discord, learn more, and then assuming you're in - click applay and follow instructions.

A helper helps others to complete tasks or solve quest related dilemmas on the ReShuffle discord server. It could be content oriented, technical help, or anything else - helpers are the first people to answer.

You do not need to be online all the time of course, but at least visit once every 2 days and when you do - try to anser as much questions in your channel as possible. Also - comment and provide positive to your quest-mates, the more - the merrier! 🥳

Like any community member - negative discussions and inaappropriate language are not welcome. Other then that - try to wvoid judgement and criticism, and just be as helpful and supportive as you can 💪
Hi! We're monitoring the ReShufflers' work and we believe you could be a great Helper 🙌 Please check out the #helper-application channel and let me know if you're inetersted 🤔

Smart decision! That’s great news 🤩
I’m going to give you the **helper** role and let your quest-mates know they can reach out for help.
Thanks!
